_comment: Teaching/lore NPC on the actor model (plan-entity-model.md chunk 3a) — formerly a statless model/npc type placed from zone.npcs, now an ordinary actor carrying an interaction block. role creature + speed 0 (PO 2026-07-27, D4): an NPC is an actor that authors no movement, not a kind of its own. Unattackable by two AUTHORED knobs (D5): faction townsfolk (friendlyToPlayers ⇒ player damage skips it) and collisionLayer 97 = PlayerStatic(1) + Viewport(32) + MobStatic(64) — solid and streamed, but deliberately NOT on Action(2), so no aura on either side can target it. interaction.range 2.0 [PLACEHOLDER] is the talk reach and sizes the one sensor. xpFactor 0 keeps it off the nameplate path; the health bar is accepted (D3). All values [PLACEHOLDER]. ⚑ QUESTS (conversation-journal Q4/R3): offers AND turns in `the-lost-lamp`, the simple three-stage version — kill 6 kobolds and his lamp is yours. His turn-in row is the ONLY source of the Lantern aura in the world (L5b — the kobold drops died with this chunk) plus 700 XP. ⚑ TEXT SHAPE (PO 2026-08-02, on top of the Q4/R1 tree shape): quest and teach text is deliberately plain — no lore or stylized wording yet; the brief states the task, accept is 'I'll do it.', the turn-in states the completed fact and names the taught skill. Quest rows carry NO quest_at_stage gate — a row is shown iff its ledger op would succeed (the Q1 show-rule). The one conditional node left is the completed-state greeting: it sits ABOVE root because the entry node is the first visible one.
